milestones.name: AppKit baseline
milestones.goal: An unchanged Intel Cocoa app opens, accepts input, resizes and saves under Darling.

milestones.name: Basic PIP framework
milestones.goal: A PIP-linked Intel fixture loads the implemented framework and completes presentation, playback-state and restoration checks under Darling.

milestones.name: TextEdit document workflow
milestones.goal: Open an existing document, edit, save, close and reopen without data loss.

milestones.name: IINA playback workflow
milestones.goal: The unchanged IINA app loads, opens media, plays audio/video, enters and exits PIP, and closes cleanly.

milestones.name: Golden Gate runtime packaging
milestones.goal: A validated Arch package installs and updates through Settings with provenance, rollback and no conflict with darling-bin.

targets.name: IINA 1.5.0
blockers: Installed Darling cannot load Apple's private PIP.framework.
The new PIP implementation has not been built into an installed Golden Gate runtime.
The Objective-C baseline excludes upstream's prebuilt Swift assets; their LFS endpoint timed out in the full-runtime attempt.
Remaining Swift, AppKit and media requirements need actual runtime tracing; resolving PIP alone does not establish compatibility.
